title: Tracing and Taming Hallucinated Terms via Subsequence-Association Filtering and Breadth-Aware Selection for LLM Query Expansion
abstract: arXiv:2610.13810v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are now a standard source of query expansion terms but they hallucinate. They inject non existent entities and off-topic terms that add ranking noise and can hurt strong retrievers. Existing remedies such as corpus grounding, mutual verification and preference alignment treat hallucinated terms as an undifferentiated nuisance to be filtered by agreement heuristics, without a mechanistic account of why a given term appears or a principled criterion for how many terms to keep. We propose Subsequence-Association Filtered, breadth-aware query expansion (SAFE-QE), a training-free, retriever agnostic method that draws on the subsequence-association account of hallucination. translated_title: 通过子序列关联过滤与广度感知选择来追踪和驯服大语言模型查询扩展中的幻觉词项
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）目前已成为查询扩展词项的标准来源，但它们会产生幻觉。它们会注入不存在的实体和偏离主题的词项，这些词项增加了排序噪声，甚至可能损害强大的检索器。现有的补救措施，如语料库接地、相互验证和偏好对齐，将幻觉词项视为不加区分的干扰因素，仅通过一致性启发式规则进行过滤，既没有对某个词项为何会出现的机制性解释，也没有关于应保留多少词项的原则性标准。我们提出了子序列关联过滤、广度感知的查询扩展方法（SAFE-QE），这是一种无需训练、与检索器无关的方法，其建立在对幻觉的子序列关联解释之上。我们根据每个候选扩展词项在语料库条件下的跨上下文可复现性对其进行评分——那些在随机化查询上下文中反复出现、却在伪相关文档集中缺乏支持的词项，会被标记为主导性幻觉的产物（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出无需训练、与检索器无关的查询扩展方法SAFE-QE，基于幻觉的子序列关联解释，通过语料库条件下的跨上下文可复现性评分追踪并过滤幻觉词项，并以广度感知的原则性标准决定保留词项的数量。
en_tdlr: SAFE-QE is a training-free, retriever-agnostic query expansion method that traces hallucinated terms via a subsequence-association account, filters them using corpus-conditioned cross-context reproducibility scores, and principledly determines how many terms to keep through breadth-aware selection.
